nodes.name: Checkout completed
nodes.notes: Registers its own signed webhook with Stripe on activation — why this workflow could not ship until the key could write webhook endpoints.

nodes.name: Get the full session
nodes.notes: Expanded for the charge id — the refund flow finds ch_... in the payment Reference, so it must be written there.

nodes.name: Find the Stripe account
nodes.notes: Looked up, not hardcoded: the Xero-Stripe integration created this bank account and its id belongs to the instance. No account found fails the run and alerts, deliberately — a payment recorded against the wrong account is worse than an email to Darren.

parameters.jsonBody: ={"Payments": [{"Invoice": {"InvoiceID": "{{ $('Shape the facts').item.json.invoiceId }}"}, "Account": {"AccountID": "{{ $json.Accounts[0].AccountID }}"}, "Date": "{{ $now.setZone('Europe/London').toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd') }}", "Amount": {{ $('Shape the facts').item.json.amount }}, "Reference": "Stripe {{ $('Shape the facts').item.json.charge }}"}]}

nodes.name: Record the payment
nodes.notes: Reference carries the charge id in the exact shape the cancellation refund flow greps for.
